description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Etamurungagoda, Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - (25/0015)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and property ownership matters. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including details of land owners, parcel numbers, extents, locations, and title classifications. The content falls under "Land Gazettes" as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements under the Registration of Title Act.
